tasks.name: deploy-cloudflare
tasks.scopedGoal: Deploy the tahiti-meetup static screen to Cloudflare Workers Assets. Read `.orchestrate/tahiti-doorkeeper/bootstrap/deploy-brief.md` for the full spec. Add wrangler.jsonc at repo root pointing assets at ./tahiti-meetup, install wrangler, deploy to account dfde833d0b10b91136eb621f0b71c687 using CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN. Commit wrangler.jsonc and package.json devDependency changes. Return the live HTTPS workers.dev URL in your handoff.
acceptance: wrangler deploy succeeds against account dfde833d0b10b91136eb621f0b71c687
Live HTTPS URL returned in handoff
Static assets include index.html, script.js, styles.css, assets/
tasks.verify:
## Setup
- `npm install` then confirm wrangler.jsonc exists

## Automated
- `curl -sI <deployed-url>` returns HTTP 200
- `curl -s <deployed-url>` contains `tahiti-meetup` branding (CURSOR, Tahiti Meetup)

## Manual
- Open URL in browser; click page; camera permission prompt appears
- After granting camera: dithered canvas animates

## Gotchas
- Must be HTTPS for getUserMedia
- Demo fallback: `<url>?demo` loads demo video without camera

tasks.name: verify-live

acceptance: HTTPS URL returns 200 with expected HTML
Demo mode (?demo) loads and renders dithered video
Verdict: pass or fail with specific gaps
